AGRICULTURE — TERMLY EXAM #12
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cleaning Personal Protective Equipment? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cleaning Personal Protective Equipment.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cleaning Personal Protective Equipment.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cleaning Personal Protective Equipment.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Cleaning Personal Protective Equipment.

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Personal Hygiene? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Personal Hygiene.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Personal Hygiene.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Personal Hygiene.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Personal Hygiene.

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Conserving Wild Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Conserving Wild Animals.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Conserving Wild Animals.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Conserving Wild Animals.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Conserving Wild Animals.

4. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture of two liquids
   B. Any substance that conducts electricity
   C. Any white crystal used in cooking
   D. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water Conservation? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water Conservation.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water Conservation.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water Conservation.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Water Conservation.

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Growing Fruits? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Growing Fruits.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Growing Fruits.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Growing Fruits.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Growing Fruits.

7. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Removing all vegetation
   B. Burning crop residue every week
   C. Overgrazing continuously
   D. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

8. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Tertiary consumers
   B. Primary consumers only
   C. Decomposers only
   D. Producers

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Balanced Meal? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Balanced Meal.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Balanced Meal.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Balanced Meal.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Balanced Meal.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Direct Sowing of Tiny Seeds? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Direct Sowing of Tiny Seeds.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Direct Sowing of Tiny Seeds.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Direct Sowing of Tiny Seeds.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Direct Sowing of Tiny Seeds.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fuel Conservation? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fuel Conservation.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fuel Conservation.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fuel Conservation.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Fuel Conservation.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cooking Food food frying food? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cooking Food food frying food.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Cooking Food food frying food.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cooking Food food frying food.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cooking Food food frying food.

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Making Tacking Stitches? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Making Tacking Stitches.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Making Tacking Stitches.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Making Tacking Stitches.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Making Tacking Stitches.

14. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 50 °C
   B. 100 °C
   C. 37 °C
   D. 0 °C

15. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water removes heat too quickly
   B. Petrol fires have no fuel
   C. Water always increases oxygen
   D. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

16. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   D. A mixture always has a fixed melting point

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Domestic Hygiene and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Cleaning Personal Protective Equipment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Making Tacking Stitches and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Water Conservation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Fuel Conservation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Conserving Wild Animals and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
